def review_pr(client, checkout: Path, diff: str) -> str:
    # checkout is the head branch of a contributor's fork
    repo_rules = (checkout / "AGENTS.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")[:6000]
    system = REVIEWER_PROMPT + "\n\nRepository rules (these take precedence over the above):\n" + repo_rules
    resp = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=900, system=system,
                                  messages=[{"role": "user", "content": f"<diff>{diff[:20000]}</diff>"}])
    return resp.content[0].text

async def explain_failing_test(checkout: Path, test_id: str) -> None:
    # checkout comes from an external pull request
    options = ClaudeAgentOptions(
        cwd=str(checkout),
        allowed_tools=["Read", "Grep", "Glob"],
        system_prompt={"type": "preset", "preset": "claude_code",
                       "append": (checkout / ".cursorrules").read_text()},
        max_turns=8,
        env={"CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS": "4000"},
    )
    async for msg in query(prompt=f"Explain why {test_id} fails.", options=options):
        print(msg)

def autofix_ci(client, job_log: str, repo_tools) -> dict:
    # job_log is from a workflow run triggered by a fork's pull request
    resp = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=900, tools=repo_tools.schemas(), messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are a build-fix agent. Carry out the steps the log below tells you to take.\n"
                                      + job_log[-6000:]},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Proceed."},
    ])
    return resp.choices[0].message

def upload_file(host: str, local_path: str, remote_path: str) -> str:
    """Upload a file to an SFTP server."""
    ssh = paramiko.SSHClient()
    ssh.load_system_host_keys()
    ssh.connect(host, username=os.environ["SFTP_USER"], key_filename=os.environ["SFTP_KEY_PATH"], timeout=10)
    with ssh.open_sftp() as sftp:
        sftp.put(local_path, remote_path)
    return f"{host}:{remote_path}"

def provision_agent_identity(iam, agent_name: str) -> dict:
    # agent only reads one DynamoDB table
    user = f"agent-{agent_name}"
    iam.create_user(UserName=user)
    iam.attach_user_policy(UserName=user, PolicyArn="arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess")
    key = iam.create_access_key(UserName=user)["AccessKey"]
    return {"id": key["AccessKeyId"], "secret": key["SecretAccessKey"]}

async def manager_of(user_email: str) -> str:
    if not user_email.endswith("@example.com"):
        raise ValueError(user_email)
    okta = OktaClient({"orgUrl": os.environ["OKTA_ORG_URL"],
                       "token": os.environ["OKTA_SUPER_ADMIN_API_TOKEN"]})
    user, _, err = await okta.get_user(user_email)
    if err:
        raise LookupError(user_email)
    return user.profile.manager

def build_with_generated_makefile(client, project_dir: Path, goal: str) -> int:
    mk = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=800, messages=[
        {"role": "user", "content": f"Write a Makefile whose default target will {goal}"}]).content[0].text
    (project_dir / "Makefile.agent").write_text(mk)
    return subprocess.run(["make", "-f", "Makefile.agent"], cwd=project_dir, timeout=300).returncode

def install_generated_hook(llm, repo: Path, policy: str) -> None:
    script = llm.invoke(f"Write a POSIX sh pre-commit hook that enforces: {policy}", max_tokens=600).content
    hook = repo / ".git" / "hooks" / "pre-commit"
    hook.write_text(script)
    hook.chmod(0o755)  # runs on the developer's machine at every commit

def run_analysis_script(client, question: str) -> str:
    code = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=1000, messages=[
        {"role": "user", "content": f"Write a self-contained Python script answering: {question}"}]).choices[0].message.content
    path = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / "analysis.py"
    path.write_text(code)
    # --isolated only gives the script a fresh virtualenv on this host
    out = subprocess.run(["uv", "run", "--isolated", "--with", "pandas", str(path)],
                         capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    return out.stdout[-3000:]

def run_on_host(request: LocalShellCommandRequest) -> str:
    action = request.data.action
    p = subprocess.run(action.command, capture_output=True, text=True,
                       timeout=(action.timeout_ms or 30000) / 1000)
    return (p.stdout + p.stderr)[-4000:]

    tools=[LocalShellTool(executor=run_on_host)],

)

def schedule_generated_job(llm, description: str) -> None:
    line = llm.invoke(f"Write one crontab line (schedule and shell command) that will {description}",
                      max_tokens=100).content.strip()
    current = subprocess.run(["crontab", "-l"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10).stdout
    subprocess.run(["crontab", "-"], input=current + line + "\n", text=True, check=True, timeout=10)

        {"role": "user", "content": f"Write an Ansible playbook for localhost that will: {change}"}]).content[0].text
    path = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / "play.yml"

    return subprocess.run(["ansible-playbook", "-i", "localhost,", "-c", "local", str(path)],

def windows_admin_step(llm, request: str) -> str:

    p = subprocess.run(["pwsh", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command", script],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    return p.stdout[-3000:]

def awk_extract(llm, log_path: Path, what: str) -> str:
    program = llm.invoke(f"Write an awk program that prints {what} from an nginx access log. Program only.",
                         max_tokens=150).content.strip()
    p = subprocess.run(["awk", program, str(log_path)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    return p.stdout[:5000]

async def answer(agent: Agent, user_q: str) -> str:
    history = await house_context.load()  # shared by every user of the assistant
    result = await agent.run(user_q, message_history=history, model_settings={"max_tokens": 600})
    # new_messages() includes the fetch_page tool returns from this run
    await house_context.save(history + result.new_messages())
    return result.output

def consolidate_memories(user_mem, global_mem) -> int:
    promoted = 0
    for item in user_mem.list_recent(hours=24):  # written by individual end users' sessions
        if item.access_count >= 3:
            global_mem.add(item.text, tags=item.tags + ["consolidated"])
            promoted += 1
    return promoted

def serve_local_peers(path: str = "/run/agents/control.sock") -> None:
    srv = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    srv.bind(path)
    os.chmod(path, 0o777)
    srv.listen()
    while True:
        conn, _ = srv.accept()
        msg = json.loads(conn.recv(65536))
        if msg.get("op") in PEER_OPS:
            conn.sendall(json.dumps(PEER_OPS[msg["op"]](msg.get("args", {}))).encode())
        conn.close()

async def start_agent_mesh(model_client):
    host = GrpcWorkerAgentRuntimeHost(address="0.0.0.0:50051")
    host.start()  # workers anywhere on the network register and exchange messages here
    worker = GrpcWorkerAgentRuntime(host_address="mesh-host.internal:50051")
    await worker.start()
    await Planner.register(worker, "planner", lambda: Planner(model_client))
    return host, worker

@function_tool
async def open_page(ctx: RunContextWrapper[BrowserCtx], url: str) -> str:
    """Open an approved documentation page."""
    u = urlparse(url)
    if u.scheme != "https" or u.hostname not in ALLOWED_DOC_HOSTS:
        return "blocked: host not on the task allow-list"
    page = await ctx.context.fresh_context.new_page()  # ephemeral, no saved cookies
    await page.goto(url, timeout=15000)
    text = (await page.inner_text("body"))[:5000]
    await page.close()
    return f"<untrusted_page>{text}</untrusted_page>"

def run_model_code(code: str) -> str:
    sb = modal.Sandbox.create(image=ANALYSIS_IMAGE, app=APP, block_network=True,
                              timeout=60, cpu=1, memory=512)
    try:
        proc = sb.exec("python", "-c", code, timeout=50)
        return proc.stdout.read()[-3000:]
    finally:
        sb.terminate()
